verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data inside MailerLite itself. Data analysis happens through natural-language prompts in Claude, an external assistant connected via MCP. The in-product AI builder is for creating landing pages, not analyzing data, and custom reports are manual grouping and filtering, not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
